notes:
Account summary: enterprise health system (50 hospitals + integrated clinics). Primary initiative: replace slow legacy clinical search with RAG-backed clinical search + reranking to surface most relevant notes and structured data snippets. Key constraints: cannot route PHI to multi-tenant hosted inference; full chain-of-custody and per-request audit trail required. CTO quote: 'We will not allow PHI to leave our environment; any third-party service must be deployable into our VPC or on-prem with HSM-backed keys.'

Requirements (high level):
- Index scale: target 30–60M clinical documents (notes, consults, imaging reports).
- Query profile: 20k QPD peak across 8am-6pm; burstable to 60k with priority routing.
- Latency: 95th pct. end-to-end (embedding + ANN + reranker) target < 200ms for triage UI, < 400ms for deep reviewer flows.
- Cost sensitivity: want <$0.10/query (embeddings + rerank) average at scale; willing to pay premium for private deployment if latency/SLOs met.
- Model preferences: open model family preferred (LLAMA/FLAN variants) with quantized variants for cost; reranker may use smaller cross-encoder tuned to clinical data.
- Routing/fallback: strict fallback rules — if private nodes saturated, degrade to cached responses or read-only BM25 fallback; no automatic fallback to hosted unless explicitly approved in runbook.

Security/compliance notes:
- Required controls: SSO/SAML, SCIM, SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, KMS integration (HSM recommended), immutable audit logs per request, retention controls (90 days for audit, document retention per policy).
- Data residency: records must remain in customer VPC or designated on-prem cluster.
- Pen-test and 3rd-party risk assessment pending (blocker for procurement).

POC ask + acceptance criteria:
- 2-week on-prem POC to index 10M docs and validate: indexing throughput (>= 1M docs/day), query latency SLO (<200ms p95 for triage), memory footprint per shard, and query cost estimation at 50M scale.
- Provide audit log schema + sample logs for review.
- Provide recommended architecture doc: HA layout, autoscaling knobs for dedicated pools, and quantization guidance for cost targets.

Recent quotes / call notes:
- "If we can't demonstrate per-query auditability and KMS integration we won't move forward." — Director of Data Governance
- "Priority is clinician trust; a single wrong retrieval that exposes PHI is a deal-breaker." — Head of Clinical Informatics

Open items / asks for Redwood team:
- Deployment blueprint for on-prem fleet (node sizing, GPU types, NVMe layout).
- Audit log retention and export APIs.
- Cost model for embeddings + reranker at 50M index with 20k QPD baseline.
- Example runbook for fallback to BM25 and cache invalidation semantics.
